goal: Produce parity-controlled, animation-first living Companion finalists and accept them only after source-jury plus bounded real-runtime context validation.

F0.name: Canonical form + motion anatomy + early runtime fit

flow: KEEP or bounded refine or REJECT

classes.AUTHORED_REFERENCE_LOCKED: Companion canonical master, identity-carrying source assets, state descendants and motion keys.
classes.PROCEDURAL_RUNTIME: Focus/attention effects, generic state transitions, layout geometry, non-identity feedback and accessibility-safe presentation behavior.
classes.DERIVED: Minimal-size, monochrome, state, motion-key or hero derivatives that retain canonical master identity.
classes.DEFER: Decorative enrichment not required to close R7-01.

asset_lifecycle.master_rule: One current canonical master/reference per finalist family. Derivatives may not silently supersede it; if a derivative drifts, the master wins unless an explicit design decision changes the master.
asset_lifecycle.isolated_source_rule: Reusable composable source assets are produced individually with clean isolation/transparent alpha when runtime composition requires it. Boards are composed only from source assets that already passed source jury.
asset_lifecycle.placeholder_rule: Keep the proven provisional renderer until the new candidate is integrated and passes production-context acceptance; replacement must remain easy to roll back during the bounded proof.

PRODUCTION_ASSET_PASS: semantic state remains owned by canonical learning/product state

semantic_authority_firewall.rule: Visuals read and express canonical learning/product truth; they never create or mutate it.

parity.camera: orthographic-like character study; no dramatic perspective
parity.lighting: soft neutral studio lighting; no colored rim light
parity.material: matte soft-touch synthetic material; no fur, cloth, glass, chrome, or glossy toy finish
parity.text_policy: candidate code and tiny view labels only; no marketing copy
parity.emotion_policy: emotion comes from whole-form orientation, tension, compression, spacing, apertures or structural alignment; never conventional face acting
parity.runtime_translation: tool remains open; design must support rig/deformation + reusable keyframed motion + bounded micro-motion

shared_hard_fails: arms, hands, legs, feet, ears, tail, hair, clothing, hat, glasses or props
continuous particles, glow, sparks or aura
abstract logo or decorative object with no living character presence
static-only form with no coherent motion anatomy

failure_codes.ROBOT_FACE_DRIFT: screen/visor/robot casing or conventional eyes/face makes the character read as an AI device or robot
failure_codes.ABSTRACT_LOGO_OBJECT_DRIFT: form reads as logo, sculpture, knot ornament or decorative object rather than a living learning character
failure_codes.GENERIC_MASCOT_DRIFT: cute face/body grammar replaces the approved structural character language
failure_codes.IDENTITY_DRIFT: approved D/Knot or E/Tilt structural identity is lost or substituted
failure_codes.WEAK_ATTENTION_SYSTEM: attention/focus cannot be read through body-integrated structural behavior
failure_codes.STATIC_ONLY: form has no credible deformation/rig anatomy for idle/listen/think/speak behavior
failure_codes.STATE_INCOHERENCE: states require unrelated redraws instead of one coherent character anatomy
failure_codes.SILHOUETTE_COLLAPSE: identity fails in filled silhouette, monochrome or minimal size
failure_codes.EFFECT_DEPENDENCE: identity/emotion depends on glow, particles, aura or decorative effects
failure_codes.RUNTIME_CONTEXT_FAIL: source visual passes in isolation but fails readability, identity, fallback, layout/accessibility or semantic-state integrity after real app integration
failure_codes.PROHIBITED_ARCHETYPE: any shared hard-fail archetype is present

D.name: D/Knot
positive_identity: single living interlaced structure formed from two broad continuous ribbons
clear over-under knot logic and deliberate negative space
attention expressed by two or three body-integrated structural apertures or tension points, never eyes
recognizable silhouette even as a solid black shape
not circular overall; avoid flower, petal, cloud and pretzel readings
D.f0_geometry: One coherent interlaced knot body; no head, torso, limbs or face. Asymmetry, apertures, directional tension and controlled deformation must make it read as a living responsive presence rather than a logo.

E.name: E/Tilt
positive_identity: single upright directional body with a clear forward tilt
one integrated folded facet or structural notch establishes orientation
composed, intentional, coach-like presence without humanoid posture
body-integrated directional hierarchy; no floating marker
strong vertical silhouette materially distinct from D/Knot
recognizable as a solid black shape at small size
not loop-based, not orb-based, not a rounded blob
E.f0_geometry: One upright tilted body with an integrated directional facet; no detached topper, tab, badge, antenna, head, limbs or face. Whole-body orientation and deformation must carry living presence.

production_mode.rule: Production limitations never reinterpret, simplify, replace or redesign D/Knot or E/Tilt.
loop: emit failure codes + concrete visual evidence
compile corrective prompt from failure codes while preserving passed traits
after source visual pass integrate bounded candidate into real renderer context
KEEP or bounded refine or REJECT
multiply descendants only after required acceptance
production_mode.jury_boundary: Jury diagnoses against the locked contract; it may not invent a new character direction.
production_mode.repair_boundary: Repair prompt addresses only diagnosed failures and explicitly preserves already-passing traits.
production_mode.surface_escape: Repeated failure of the same class is evidence to change production surface/workflow, not to weaken the design contract.
production_mode.implementation_boundary: Runtime/vector/rig technology may translate an approved character later; it is not design authority.
production_mode.evidence_boundary: Routine reversible iterations use internal jury + bounded runtime checks. Durable evidence/independent review is reserved for material risk or the controlling Round 7 gate under D-064/D-065.
